entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
Aotearoa New Zealand’s wool is shaping a sustainable future. 🐑
Ethical, renewable, and proudly part of our heritage, New Zealand wool is driving innovation and offering a natural alternative to synthetics. @CampaignForWoolNZ  is creating global awareness of its benefits, @wisewool9633  is leading with 100% natural products, and @yynation  is crafting some of the world’s most sustainable footwear using merino wool. Together, these Kiwi innovators are proving wool is powering our future.
